 The lab of Henry Levin in the NICHD is now seeking a postdoctoral fellow to study a polymorphic Alu insertion found to be a causal candidate for increased risk of Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). 
 About the position 
 Our current studies focus on the integration of transposable elements and how de novo insertion modifies host biology. Our experimental systems include the LTR retrotransposon of fission yeast, HIV-1 in human cells, and L1 in human cells. ucla-recruit:JPF11472.title: Postdoctoral Scholar in the Department of Earth, Planetary, and Space Sciences at the University of California, Los Angeles (EPSS/UCLA)
ucla-recruit:JPF11472.snippet:
Description 
 The Department of Earth, Planetary, and Space Sciences at the University of California, Los Angeles, seeks applicants for a Postdoctoral Scholar as part of the Multiscale Physics of Clouds Across Planetary Atmospheres collaboration, funded by the Simons Foundation. The collaboration is seeking 8 postdoctoral researchers to develop new approaches to understanding clouds across Solar System, exoplanet, and brown dwarf atmospheres. The candidate must hold a Ph.D. in Earth sciences, astronomy, planetary science, atmospheric science or related fields. 
 UCLA is one of 7 host institutions internationally, with each researcher working on a distinct project within the broader collaboration. Projects span topics including cloud microphysics, atmospheric dynamics, radiative transfer, laboratory and experimental studies, observations, and computational modeling. We welcome applicants
